pred_texts: Instruct: Get a one pound of broccoli and cut the florets.
Instruct: Now get a bell pepper and chop it into small pieces.
Instruct: Now take a pan and oil and add oil to the pan.
Instruct: Now turn on the stove.
Instruct: Now add the cut broccoli to the pan.
Instruct: Now add the cut bell pepper.
Instruct: Now cut a beetroot and add it to the pan.
Instruct: Now add approx 1 cup of spinach to the pan.
Instruct: Now you need to stir the contents of the pan and add salt to taste to the pan.
Instruct: Now add pepper to taste.
